definitions.claim: One canonical claim record in knowledge/claim_graph.json.
definitions.citation_context: One claim-to-citation context; the same citation may support multiple claims.
definitions.graph_edge: One explicit edge in the native claim graph.
definitions.unique_citation: One distinct citation key across all claim citation contexts.
definitions.verified_passage: One passage whose verification_status is verified; contexts may contain multiple passages.
definitions.human_decision: One historical reviewer decision record; a decision may replace one source claim with several claims.
definitions.replacement_claim: One claim record authored inside a historical human decision.
definitions.human_review_flag: A current graph claim with human_review_required=true; this is pending work, not a completed decision.
definitions.source_reviewed_relation: An exported relation whose current claim text matches a replacement claim from a source-side human decision.
